label: Dawn
description: Masters of war in all its forms, the Children of the Dawn were once the leaders and champions of the Celestial Armies. The Unconquered Sun chooses the Dawn Caste from those with a talent for the arts of combat and war.
anima_powers: By spending 10 motes, the character appears huge and terrifying for the rest of the scene (or until she lets the effect dissipate). Mortals trying to face her must make a Valor check or suffer -2 dice on all attacks against her; those who botch the roll (and most natural animals) flee in terror. Golems, automata, demons, the undead and others that know no fear are immune.

label: Zenith
description: Once the leaders of the Solar Exalted, the Lightbringers are priest-kings, prophets and mystics. The Unconquered Sun chooses the Zenith Caste from those most fit for righteousness and justice, as well as from among the leaders of men.
anima_powers: With a touch, the character burns the body of a fallen creature for 1 mote per body, sending the smoke and soul to Heaven and preventing it from rising as a zombie or hungry ghost. As her action for a turn, she may channel 5 motes to strike a demon, undead or other creature of darkness within 10 yards, rolling her Essence as dice of unsoakable aggravated damage.

label: Twilight
description: Scholars and craftsmen of the Solar Exalted, the Children of Twilight are thinkers and doers. The Unconquered Sun chooses the Twilight Caste from those most able to take knowledge and apply it to create concrete results.
anima_powers: As a last-ditch protective act, after damage is rolled but before health levels are lost, the character may spend 5 motes and roll her Essence; each success subtracts one health level from the incoming damage, potentially turning a deadly blow harmless.

label: Night
description: Lords of stealth and trickery, the Concealing Shadows once served as the security of the Celestial Empire. The Unconquered Sun chooses the Night Caste from those who excel in entering places where they are not wanted or in finding unconventional solutions to problems.
anima_powers: The character may mute her anima: when spending peripheral Essence she pays twice as many motes to keep the expenditure from adding to her anima banner (this does not mute displays caused by sorcery). She may also spend 10 motes to extend the muting as a veil around her for a scene, increasing the difficulty of all rolls to detect or track her by 1.

label: Eclipse
description: Diplomats and bureaucrats, the Crowned Suns were the force that kept the Celestial Empire running smoothly. The Unconquered Sun chooses the Eclipse Caste from those who master the art of communication in all its forms.
anima_powers: By spending 10 motes and 1 Willpower and touching hands to seal an agreement, the character sanctifies an oath. Anyone who breaks it (including the Exalted) is cursed: a number of times equal to the Exalted's Essence at the time of the oath, the oathbreaker horribly botches a critical roll at the worst possible moment. Eclipses are also protected by ancient pacts, granting diplomatic immunity when dealing with spirits, demons and the Fair Folk.

label: Air
description: Creatures of thought and dreams, the Children of Mela are as subtle as a gentle breeze and as dynamic as a thunderstorm. Air Exalted excel at scholarship and subtle motion.
anima_powers: An Aspect of Air can spend 5 motes to attune his anima to the nearby winds, allowing them to bear him aloft. For the rest of the scene, he may triple his leaping distance and takes no damage from falls.

label: Earth
description: Embodiments of endurance and stability, the Children of Pasiap are the bedrock upon which the Realm sits — durable as a mountain and as unstoppable as an avalanche.
anima_powers: An Aspect of Earth can spend 5 motes to attune her anima to the nearby stone, taking on the durability of the earth itself. For the rest of the scene, she can soak lethal damage with her entire Stamina.

label: Fire
description: Passion and energy incarnate, the Children of Hesiesh are as brilliant as a bonfire and as dangerous as a wildfire, brimming with physical and emotional energy.
anima_powers: A Fire-aspected Dragon-Blooded can spend 5 motes to ignite her anima. For the rest of the scene she is immune to fire damage, and anyone striking her without a weapon or wrestling with her takes a number of dice of lethal damage every turn equal to the Chosen's Essence (applied separately from any damage she deals; armour applies to it).

label: Water
description: Mercurial and fluid-minded masters of adaptation, the Children of Daana'd are as deep as the ocean and as relentless as a flood, filling and exploiting any circumstance.
anima_powers: An Aspect of Water can spend 5 motes to attune his anima with the surrounding water. For the rest of the day he can breathe underwater and operate as freely as if he were in air, including firing bows and the like.

label: Wood
description: Attuned to the cycles of life and nature, the Children of Sextes Jylis are as solid as oaks, as beautiful as orchids and as deadly as hemlock.
anima_powers: A Wood-aspected Dragon-Blooded may spend 5 motes to attune her anima to the local flora, becoming as flexible as a sapling in the wind. For the rest of the scene she may add her Essence in dice to a single Dodge or Athletics action once per turn (reflexive, not supplemental — she may instead take a free Dodge or Athletics action with a dice pool equal to her Essence).

label: Dusk
description: Masters of bringing death through war, the Peacebringers are the leaders and champions of the Underworld's armies. The Deathlords choose the Dusk Caste from those with a talent for the arts of combat and weaponry.
anima_powers: By spending 10 motes of Essence, the deathknight appears dark and terrible for the rest of the scene (or until he lets the effect dissipate). Mortals attempting to face him must make a Valor check or be unable to look directly at him or strongly oppose him, taking -2 dice on all attempts to attack him. Those who botch the Valor roll — and most natural animals — flee in terror.

label: Midnight
description: The Echoes of the Abyss are high priests and evangelists of death. The Deathlords choose the Midnight Caste from those who crave the end of all life and wish to awaken that craving in others.
anima_powers: With a touch, the deathknight raises the fallen: she spends 5 motes of Essence and touches a corpse, which rises as a zombie (permanent duration, always an extra) by the end of the scene. She may also strike down the living with an icy glance — as her action she channels 5 motes of Essence through her anima and indicates a normal mortal within 10 yards, inflicting her Essence in dice of unsoakable aggravated damage. This glance has no effect on the Fair Folk, the Exalted or other magical beings.

label: Daybreak
description: Necromancers and craftsmen of the Abyssal Exalted, the Children of Bone are dark and morbid artisans. The Deathlords choose the Daybreak Caste from those who seek the darkest forms of knowledge and apply it to create horrifying results.
anima_powers: After an enemy has rolled damage that would cost the deathknight health levels, he may spend 5 motes of Essence to fill his anima with the power of the Underworld and blunt the blow. Roll his Essence: each success subtracts one health level from the damage — enough to reduce a weak attack to harmlessness or survive an otherwise-deadly strike.

label: Day
description: Lords of stealth and trickery, the Daywalkers walk unseen among the living. The Deathlords choose the Day Caste from those who excel in entering places where they are not wanted or in finding unconventional ways of bringing death.
anima_powers: The Day Caste can mute their animas. By doubling the motes spent, the deathknight prevents an expenditure of Peripheral Essence from adding to her anima banner (this cannot mute the Essence display of sorcery). She may also spend 5 motes of Essence to extend her muted anima like a choking cloak for the scene, dulling the senses of those who would perceive her or follow her trail — increasing the difficulty of all rolls to detect or track her by 1.

label: Moonshadow
description: Diplomats and bureaucrats, the Hollow Darkness is the force that keeps the empires of the dead running smoothly. The Deathlords chose the Moonshadow Caste from those who master the arts of negotiation, travel and treachery.
anima_powers: When party or witness to an oath, the deathknight may sanctify it: touching the hands of those sworn, he spends 10 motes of Essence and 1 Willpower. An oathbreaker suffers terrible luck, horribly botching a critical roll a number of times equal to the deathknight's Essence when he witnessed the oath. Moonshadows are also gifted generalists — with a willing tutor they may learn the Charms of other Exalted and even spirits (including ghosts), though such Charms cost double the experience to learn and use.
